title: 北京市中小学人工智能教育地方课程纲要（试行）（2025年版） (Beijing Education Commission)
notes: Beijing Municipal Education Commission (primary/official), 京教基二〔2025〕6号, 2025-06-26, 现行有效. Issued Beijing Local Curriculum Outline for AI Education in Primary/Secondary Schools (Trial, 2025 ed) to promote high-quality AI-ed implementation. Basis: MOE General Office notice 教基厅函〔2024〕32号 (cf. source 93) + Beijing work plan 京教办〔2025〕2号 (2025-2027). Addressees: district ed commissions, Yanshan, E-Tech Dev Area, directly-affiliated schools.
